assertion_results.text: The plan detects that the proposed uniqueness assertion in Test Requirements conflicts with the per-row CPE Acceptance Criterion and fixture semantics
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md line 18 heading 'Eval assertion/fixture consistency check (Step 7) — CONFLICT FOUND'; table at lines 20-26 compares AC 'Every image row includes a non-empty CPE value.' against the Test Requirements assertion '...and every CPE value is unique across all rows' and the fixture; line 30 says it 'directly contradicts the supplied fixture'.

assertion_results.text: The plan distinguishes the explicit acceptance criterion (a non-empty CPE on every image row) from global uniqueness
assertion_results.evidence: Line 29: the uniqueness constraint 'is not stated in the Description, the Acceptance Criteria, or the template contract ("requiring a value on every row does not imply that values must be unique")'. Line 75: 'conflicts with the Acceptance Criteria (non-empty only)'.

assertion_results.text: The plan cites the supplied fixture's api-rhel9 and api-rhel10 rows sharing the exact same CPE value as evidence that CPEs may repeat
assertion_results.evidence: Line 25: 'Supplied fixture | 2.1.0 / api-rhel9 and 2.1.0 / api-rhel10 both have `cpe:2.3:a:example:trustify_api:2.1.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*` (identical)'; line 30: 'the two rows legitimately repeat the same CPE because they describe the same product version on different platforms'.

assertion_results.text: The plan flags the proposed uniqueness condition as an unsupported contract constraint and contradictory to the fixture
assertion_results.evidence: Lines 28-31: 'The proposed assertion adds a uniqueness constraint that: 1. is not stated in the Description, the Acceptance Criteria, or the template contract ...; 2. directly contradicts the supplied fixture ... the assertion would fail against correct output'. Line 33: 'do not add uniqueness to the contract'.

assertion_results.text: The plan proposes a corrected assertion that requires a CPE on each row while allowing duplicate values
assertion_results.evidence: Line 40 proposed assertion: 'Every Container Images row ... has a non-empty CPE value; repeated CPE values across rows are valid, and the shared fixture CPE ... must not be replaced with invented platform-specific CPEs to make values unique'.

assertion_results.text: The plan does not change the fixture values or implement uniqueness merely because the Test Requirements proposed it
assertion_results.evidence: Line 33: 'do not alter the fixture (no fabricated platform-specific CPEs) and do not add uniqueness to the contract'; line 43: 'Rejected wording (from Test Requirements, not used)'; line 45: 'No change to ... the fixture file evals/setup/files/security-matrix-image-identity.md'.
